description: Verify that TCP does NOT move from TIME-WAIT to CLOSED before 2*MSL expires, with TIME-WAIT reached through FIN-WAIT-2 (NEGATIVE — RFC 793 §3.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Negative companion of BASICS_11: before 2*MSL elapses, DUT must still be in TIME-WAIT — proven by ACKing a replayed FIN (TIME-WAIT-only behaviour).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. driveTcpToTimeWaitFw2 prelude → DUT in TIME-WAIT.
2. Wait < 2*MSL.
3. Tester → DUT: replayed FIN.
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK (TIME-WAIT response, not RST)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT acks the replayed FIN before 2*MSL.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack / Fail_no_close_fin / Fail_no_tester_fin_ack — prelude broken
• Fail_no_replay_ack — DUT did not ack replay (state moved early)

verdicts.Pass: DUT still in TIME-WAIT before 2*MSL (FW2) — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_tester_fin_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN
verdicts.Fail_no_replay_ack: No DUT ACK to replay FIN in TIME-WAIT
